source.citation: Kettler, R. M., Wesolowski, D. J., Palmer, D. A. (1992). Dissociation quotients of malonic acid in aqueous sodium chloride media to 100 C. Journal of Solution Chemistry 21, 883-900.

transcription.note: Replaces two textbook pKa of malonic acid (2.83 and 5.69) that test/published_values.jl quoted without a source.

log_K1.description: Decimal logarithm of the first thermodynamic dissociation constant of malonic acid at 25 C, from the regression of the authors' and previously published quotients.

log_K2.description: The same for the second dissociation, bimalonate to malonate.
